title: Chen Nian's Choice
next_chapter_hook: Just as the ancient ruins trembled with a thunderous roar, the will dormant for ten thousand years deep within the Tianji Record fully awakened. It sensed the disturbance on the fourth page—the fate's key belonging to Chen Nian was breaking free from the chess game it had meticulously arranged over millennia.

text.content: The searing heat of the Tianji Record nearly scorched through Chen Ji's palm. The ten-thousand-year-dormant will surged into his Mental Sea like a tide—cold, vast, and irresistible. "Found you." A voice echoed in the depths of his soul, devoid of any emotion, yet it made every hair on Chen Ji's body stand on end. This was the will projection of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, and it had finally noticed this ant who dared to peer into heavenly secrets.

dialogue.content: A slight smile curved Chen Ji's lips, yet cold sweat seeped from his palm. He did not retreat; instead, he faced the pressure and slowly spoke: "Ten thousand years is too long. Have you high and mighty beings forgotten—the distinction between chess piece and chess player often flips with a single thought." His voice was terrifyingly calm, though his Mental Sea was churned like raging seas by that will.

text.content: Just then, a clear sword cry echoed from the depths of the ruins, followed by a brilliant light shooting toward the sky. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—that was the direction of the fourth page, where Chen Nian was trapped. The Tianji Record's pressure suddenly faltered, seemingly also drawn by that light.

dialogue.content: "Brother..." A voice slightly trembling yet incomparably firm came from within the light. Chen Nian's figure slowly emerged, surrounded by countless golden inscriptions—the power of the 'Heavenly Fate Key' sealed by the Holy Sect for years. Her eyes no longer held the past confusion, but a clarity that perceived all things. "I saw it, I saw everything."

text.content: With each step Chen Nian took, the inscriptions around her grew brighter. Her consciousness had been sealed, used as a tool by the Holy Sect, and treated as a backup piece by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. But now, that gaze of ten-thousand-year will was like a key, unlocking her deepest shackles. Independent will, completely awakened at this moment.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian stopped three feet away from Chen Ji, her gaze sweeping over the scorching Tianji Record, a bitter smile appearing at the corner of her lips: "Brother, do you know? The fourth page was never a cultivation technique fragment—it was the prison the Eye of Heavenly Secrets used to imprison my soul. I am the fourth page, and the fourth page is me."

text.content: Chen Ji's breath halted for a moment. He should have realized it long ago—why the fourth page's prophecies were always vague, why all foresight images involving Chen Nian were filled with static-like noise. It wasn't that the Tianji Record was incomplete, but because Chen Nian herself was part of it. She was the Heavenly Fate Key, the lock, and the thing being locked.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian raised her hand and gently pressed it on the scorching pages. That ten-thousand-year will let out an enraged roar, the pressure suddenly intensifying, and the stone pillars of the ruins began to collapse. "For ten thousand years, you treated me as a chess piece, as a tool." Chen Nian's voice was calm yet carried unstoppable fury, "Today, I will personally sever these chains."

choice.prompt: Chen Nian is about to make a crucial choice. She can break free from the fourth page's shackles, but the price is losing part of her Heavenly Fate power, and it may also trigger the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' full counterattack. As her brother, how will Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Chen Nian has just awakened, her foundation is unstable. Acting recklessly could lead to utter destruction. Stabilize the situation first and plan for later.
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Secrets will not give you any respite

text.content: Chen Ji reached out to stop her, but the moment he touched Chen Nian's shoulder, he felt a scorching force push his hand away. "Brother, do you think I'm still that little girl who needs your protection?" Chen Nian turned back, her eyes filled with determination.

result_nodes.description: Chen Nian has awakened. She has the right to choose her own destiny. Siblings unite, resist Heaven together.
result_nodes.visible_cost: Face the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' full counterattack
result_nodes.visible_reward: The relationship between Chen Nian and the Tianji Record will completely change
result_nodes.risk_hint: You may both become the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' primary targets

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his hand, was silent for a moment, then a familiar arc appeared at the corner of his lips: "Fine. Since my sister Chen Ji wants to be a chess player, as her brother I should naturally clear the obstacles for her." His gaze suddenly turned sharp.

The moment Chen Ji finished speaking, the Tianji Record erupted with dazzling light. That ten-thousand-year will was no longer mere pressure but had become a physical attack. Countless chains condensed from Heavenly Dao laws shot out from the pages, rushing straight toward Chen Nian. The ruins' dome began to collapse, debris falling like rain.

dialogue.content: "A mere key dares to break free from Heavenly Fate's shackles?" That cold voice echoed through the ruins, carrying the air of a high-handed judgment, "Chen Nian, your existence was meant to complete the Tianji Record. Since you've voluntarily taken this step—then stay forever in the river of history."

choice.prompt: The Eye of Heavenly Secrets has launched its attack. Chen Ji must make an instant decision. Protecting Chen Nian requires a price, and his Tianji Record foresight ability might find a weakness.

choices.text: Burn Heavenly Fate to activate foresight
choices.description: Immediately consume 10 Heavenly Fate points to peer three breaths into the future battle situation, seeking the key to breaking the deadlock.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate points -10. Insufficient remaining Heavenly Fate may lead to backlash
choices.risk_hint: Each foresight will increase the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' lock on you

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate to press his hand on the Tianji Record. The scalding pages nearly burned through his palm. Images flooded into his mind like a tide—three breaths later, those chains would have a fatal three-inch gap.

choices.text: Block in front of Chen Nian with his body
choices.description: No prediction, directly use his body to buy Chen Nian time to break free. Pure force confrontation.
choices.visible_reward: Win Chen Nian complete awakening time
choices.risk_hint: Without foresight enhancement, you will rely entirely on instinct and reaction

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate for even a moment. His figure darted forward, arms spread wide, blocking in front of Chen Nian. The chains struck his back viciously, intense pain传来, blood instantly soaking his robes. But he stood straight, not retreating a single step.

Blood dripped from Chen Ji's chin, staining the pages of the Tianji Record. Something strange happened—those pages touched by Chen Ji's blood began to tremble violently. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets' will let out an incredulous roar. "Impossible! How do you possess the bloodline of the Progenitor!"

dialogue.content: Chen Nian was stunned. She watched her brother's blood-soaked back, his spine straight despite the intense pain that made him tremble, and her eyes instantly moistened. "Brother... why never told me?" Her voice carried a sob, yet also a resolve, "Since that's the case, I cannot disappoint you even more."

text.content: Chen Nian formed seals with both hands. The golden inscriptions around her suddenly exploded outward, turning into countless tiny points of light that merged into her body. Those light points were not power, but memories devoured by the Tianji Record over ten thousand years—memories of her ancestors, memories of the inheritor 'Chen Xuan.' She finally understood everything.

dialogue.content: "Brother, the fourth page of the Tianji Record is not a prison—it is a shackle, but a shackle can also become a weapon." Chen Nian's voice no longer trembled but was full of power, "I will tear it away from the Tianji Record and refine it into something of my own. From now on, I am no longer a chess piece."

choice.prompt: Chen Nian is about to complete her final transformation. But separating the fourth page means a complete break from the Tianji Record's main body. At this moment, Chen Ji must make a choice—help her complete this world-shaking act, or advise her to reconsider?

choices.description: Pour your own Heavenly Fate power into the Tianji Record, creating a stable channel for Chen Nian's separation.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate points -20, may fall into a weakened state
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian gains complete power independent of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The separation process is irreversible. Once begun, it cannot be stopped

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate to press both hands on the Tianji Record, guiding his Heavenly Fate power into that separation channel. Intense pain came, his vision began to blur, but he bit down hard, not making a single sound.

choices.text: Advise her to preserve the connection
choices.description: Complete separation is too dangerous. Suggest she preserve part of the connection as a trump card for future resurgence.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian's power will be incomplete
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the possibility of recontrolling the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: This may make Chen Nian feel you're still making decisions for her

text.content: Chen Ji opened his mouth, reason told him he should advise Chen Nian to preserve the connection. But looking at his sister's determined eyes, he suddenly laughed: "Forget it. Do whatever you want. After all, you're my sister Chen Ji—who dares say otherwise?"

The Eye of Heavenly Secrets' will let out a furious roar. Countless chains frantically surged toward both of them. But Chen Ji had already seen that three-inch gap. He猛地侧身, the chains whistling past his shoulder. Meanwhile, Chen Nian's hands suddenly pressed together, golden light shooting toward the sky.

dialogue.content: "No! You siblings, do not think to escape my chess game!" The Eye of Heavenly Secrets' voice carried panic for the first time, "I have been arranging this game for ten thousand years. How could I let such insignificant ants destroy it!"

text.content: There was no fear in Chen Nian's eyes, only resolve. "Arranged for ten thousand years?" Her voice was cold and mocking, "Unfortunately, you overlooked one thing—if chess pieces develop their own will, the chess game is no longer yours." As her words fell, she spat out a mouthful of refined blood, turning into a blood-colored rune that狠狠印在了第四页之上.

The Tianji Record let out a mournful wail. The golden pages trembled violently. The fourth page slowly separated from the main body, trailing golden sparks and blood-colored patterns. Chen Nian reached out to catch that fragment, pressing it into her Brow Center. In an instant, her aura surged暴涨, power erupting around her capable of tearing apart the heavens.

Chen Ji watched this scene, a relieved smile appearing on his lips. His sister was finally no one's chess piece. "Does it hurt?" he asked, his voice hoarse yet gentle. Chen Nian turned around, eyes red-rimmed yet smiling brilliantly: "No. Brother, with you here, I'm not afraid of anything."

After losing the fourth page, the Tianji Record's main body suddenly dimmed. That ten-thousand-year will let out an unwilling roar before gradually falling silent. But just as Chen Ji thought everything was settled, Mo Xiansheng's weak voice came from deep within the Tianji Record: "Well done, children... But this is only the beginning. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets has only temporarily retreated. It will return soon. And next time, it will not give you any chance at all."
